description: This file contains security-related utility functions for the backend of a task flow collaboration platform, including password hashing, password verification, JWT token creation (access and refresh), and token decoding. It also imports configuration settings.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional expiration.

methods.name: str create_refresh_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT refresh token with optional expiration.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token and returns the payload if valid.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str:$/

ctags.name: create_refresh_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_refresh_token(data: dict[str, Any], expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> str/
